title: Cold gives way to rain in parts of UK as weather warning issued for south-west England
summary_full: Flood alerts in place and risk of power cuts as more than 100mm predicted to fall on Dartmoor on SundayCold snaps are to make way for heavy rain in some parts of the country as the Met Office issued a weather warning for south-west England.It said there will be a slow-moving band of rain moving across Devon and Cornwall, with more than 100mm due to fall on Dartmoor. The warning will be in place from 6am on Sunday until midnight. Continue reading...
